attractions.name: Tirta Ganga Water Palace
attractions.description: Former royal water palace with fountains, koi-filled ponds, stone pathways and landscaped gardens

attractions.name: Lempuyang Temple (Gates of Heaven)
attractions.description: Sacred temple complex on the slopes of Mount Lempuyang with the famous Gates of Heaven framing Mount Agung on clear mornings
attractions.dress_code: Shoulders and knees covered; sarongs usually provided
tips: Start early as photo queues become lengthy later in the day
Carry a light jacket for the cooler mountain climate
Keep sunglasses, phones and loose items secure as monkeys may grab them

safety_tips.tip: Keep sunglasses, phones and loose items secure at temples as monkeys may grab visible objects
